Dr Mya reassures a mum with agonising leg injuries after the woman was squashed between the motorbike she was on and a 4WD. A teen with a machete wound to his arm has Dr Michael on alert. Dr Mark and Dr Tessa treat self-described ‘idiot’ Paul, who has fallen ten metres from a tree, with a chainsaw. A footballer knows which bones he’s broken, but not how he did it.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Mya’s stabbing victim is hanging on to life with uncontrolled bleeding. Dr David’s patient has potential spinal injuries after crashing onto his head during a mountain bike race. Dr Emma and Dr Jonathan are worried about a great-grandmother with disastrous chest injuries from a car accident. A pregnant mother has Dr George and Dr Caitlin concerned, as the woman hasn’t felt her baby move at all. To help the doctors de-stress, Milo the dog proves a hit during bring your dog to work day.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A quad-bike accident has a race-track worker needing all of Dr Michelle’s skills, but his X-ray results confuse everyone. Dr Emma has a young man’s life in her hands as he bleeds profusely from the throat. Dr Catriona is worried a tradie might lose his sight after he comes in with terrible injuries from a workplace accident. Dr George and Dr Rosie need to electrocute the heart of a father of two. Dr Michelle challenges Dr Mya to an 8km fun run but Mya doesn’t fill Michelle with confidence.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Michelle and Dr Jonathan’s car crash patient, a nursing student, has such terrible injuries her life hangs in the balance. Dr George’s truck accident victim needs two tourniquets above the knee to stop severe blood loss, but if they don’t come off he’ll lose his leg. Dr Mya’s special brand of TLC helps a young woman in physical and emotional pain. Dr Michael is impressed with an 81-year-old man who walked in to hospital on his broken leg, but the man’s dizzy spells has Michael worried.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A car crash survivor needs litres of blood, but Dr Martin is struggling to find a vein that hasn’t collapsed. Dr Mya is juggling patients like balls in the air and hoping not to drop any. Dr Michael examines a motorbike rider with a damaged shoulder and smashed leg. He wants his mum, so ‘Mama Bear’ Gina steps in. Dr Andrew has a wee problem being understood, but the soon-to-be-Aussie has bigger issues with a young footballer showing signs of spinal and internal injuries after a hard tackle.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Ebony and Dr Jonathan are on high alert as their patient could turn on them without warning. Dr Mya and Dr David treat a young woman with a broken jaw who is at risk of choking after falling face-first off, her horse and is in a world of pain. Dr Luke and Dr Emma are grateful for a good early sign from a motorbike rider who collided with a car, but alarms soon ring out. Dr Tessa is astounded by a bush remedy used when a farm worker on a forklift fell in high winds, cracking his head.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Michelle and Dr Emma are on high alert for a mother-to-be who is paralysed and unresponsive from a suspected stroke. Every second counts as Dr Bjorn and Dr Martin’s critically injured patient clings to life after a one-tonne camper trailer rolled over him. A confused motorbike rider remembers nothing and feels no pain while Dr Michael searches for chest, spinal and brain injuries. Pregnant Dr Jana needs a covid-free room to drink water, then is back to re-set an artist’s broken wrists.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Sarah must numb a nursing student’s hand to clean her mangled fingers, but the woman won’t let her because she’s terrified of needles. Dr Ali suspects a former war correspondent has serious spinal injuries after the man rolled his car. First-time dads Dr Michael and Dr Luke swap nappy tales before it’s all hands on deck for a motorcycle rider with multiple fractures. Dr Emma and Nurse Emma fear a stoic 79-year-old grandmother might lose her leg after she was hit by a car crossing the street.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Trauma patients pour through the doors. Dr Jason searches a teen’s mud-encrusted body for breaks after the dirt-bike rider crashed in a race. Nurse Elle and Dr Steve suspect a cyclist with a badly broken leg is being far too brave, masking other injuries. Dr Mya and Dr Matt fear a young tradie could have a life-altering spinal injury after a fall at work. Dr Michelle puts lunch on hold as she and Dr Jonathan examine a 67-year-old motorbike rider for broken bones.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every eleven seconds a cry for help comes through to emergency services. Flight paramedic Steve heads to the country after a tractor topples over and crushes a farmer. Taz and new teammate Erika hope for the best and prepare for the worst as a much-loved grandma collapses at home. A woman having multiple seizures has Michaela and Simon on high alert. The mother of two’s life is in their hands as she can’t breathe for herself. Steve and Jade’s patient has severe pain, but what’s causing it?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Alarm bells ring for Michaela, as a super-fit dad suddenly has slurred speech. Father-daughter team Brett and Teagan finally work together. They’re shocked by the deep gash on a woman’s leg after tumbling downstairs. Eamon and Mike are teaming up again, helping an elderly asthmatic man who can’t stop coughing. Veterans Doddsy and Andrew’s day is upended as they race to a motorcyclist crash victim with extensive injuries. A six-month-old baby gives Leonard and Cullen a huge scare.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam is confronted with carnage after a motorcyclist crashes into parked cars in a suburban street. The treatment Cam needs to perform could go horribly wrong, but without it, the patient will stop breathing. New partners Jodie and Nathan rush to an overheated triathlete who collapses over the finish line. Steve and the flight crew hold a rural GP’s life in their hands. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stoic 96-year-old is downplaying her symptoms as they look for signs of a ‘silent heart attack’.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Nicola and Risky have a quick catch up before it’s straight back to work, treating a disoriented driver who’s had a seizure and crashed her car. Mike and Eamon get all the red flags while treating a mother who’s having a stroke. Simon and Michaela work in cramped conditions, extracting an unconscious young man who’s collapsed at work and is unresponsive. Jodie and Nathan need police help to stay safe while tending an upset patient who’s putting himself and others in danger.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: In Victoria, a cry for help comes to emergency services every eleven seconds. Newly-minted MICA paramedic Leonard needs all his skills to help a karate student make it back from the brink of a cardiac arrest. Taz and Erika’s fragile patient starts to come good, then deteriorates fast in the ambulance. Flight paramedic Steve and the team respond to a horrific crash, where a single mum has gone off a bridge and landed into a river. Cam races to a young man with mysterious abdominal pain.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Simon and Michaela mentor a new paramedic in high-demand hands-on revival skills after a young man takes a heroin overdose. Mike and Eamon worry a teen could have life-changing head injuries after a fall and seizure at school. Nicola and Risky check an older driver for spinal fractures after a crash leaves him in agony, and he feels every bump on the way to hospital. Steve and Jade deliver essential care for an incredible woman whose deteriorating health is on a knife edge.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: An elite team is ready to save people having their worst day. Alarm bells ring for Cam and Doddsy after a healthy man collapses having multiple seizures. Jade is impressed with Steve’s skills as they support a scared patient who’s struggling to breathe with suspected Covid. Leonard and Cullen attempt a trick-move to stop a woman’s heart from racing. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stressed-out fraud victim could be having a heart attack.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Flight Paramedic Steve worries a teen motorbike rider could lose his leg, after a high-speed crash. MICA Matt faces a grim scenario, as a dearly loved great grandfather’s lung collapses. Taz and Erica are on high alert, when a drug-affected woman wanders onto the street. Father and daughter team Brett and Teagan have a gut-wrenching situation as a mother can’t wake her seven-year-old child. Mike and Eamon rush to a man who collapses in a pizza restaurant before his meal arrives.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Steve and Jade carry a top range of painkillers, but their motorbike crash victim won’t take any. Traffic slows Simon and Michaela as they race to a heart attack survivor drifting in and out of consciousness. Single-responder Jodie’s chest-pain patient has an alarming medical history. Marlie and Tanie’s elderly patient is in agony from a fall and can’t explain what’s happened. Father-Daughter team Teagan and Brett are called to a potential heart attack, but their patient is only in his teens.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: MICA paramedics Nathan and Jodie patch up a dirtbike rider who’s fallen five metres and landed on his bum. A suburban shooting has Cam and Al battling to save a young man’s life. He’s in critical condition with an open chest wound. Risky and Nicola are super-impressed with a spritely but unsteady 92-year-old. A road accident has given a young driver some small cuts, and Mike and Eamon then check for deeper injuries. An elderly woman’s dizzy symptoms puzzle single-responder Andrew.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, trauma patients arrive around the clock for urgent care. Doctors Scott Taylor and Jonathan Papson fear for a pregnant woman injured in a high-speed traffic accident. Doctors Andrew Wallace and Jana Alexander urgently treat a jockey who was crushed under a horse. Doctor Jason Gabriel-Anyassor’s patient is in agony after crashing into a truck. Dr Martin Dutch and Nurse Sarah Thomas resort to translator apps to communicate with a scared young tourist hit by a car.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: It’s Manic Monday at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as trauma patients pour in. Dr George Plunkett and Nurse Sarah Thomas worry a motorbike rider could lose his leg. Doctor Glenn Harrison fears a tradie, crushed under 300 kilos of cement, has brain injuries. Drs Emma West and Mya Cubitt celebrate Dr Jana Alexander’s return from maternity leave with cake, then Dr Mya and Dr Jana diagnose a ‘healthy’ man with a ticking time bomb. Dr Emma investigates a pregnant woman’s chest and leg pains.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Lives hang in the balance at the Royal Melbourne Hospital. Dr Mark Putland and the Trauma team have minutes to save a truck driver’s severed leg. Drs Andrew Trezise and Emma West search for neck injuries on a cyclist who’s collided with a van. Then Nurse Eliza Burke notices a red flag. Drs Michael Conboy and Steve Pincus struggle to relocate a student’s jaw after he yawned. Dr Andrew Wallace and Nurse Chelsea Jones fear a champion horse rider might be paralysed after a hard fall.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: For 175 years, the Royal Melbourne Hospital has rescued people having their worst day. Doctor Scott Taylor fears a tradie has life-altering neck damage after a ladder fall. Nurse Susan Hartman keeps the man completely still, but soon his breathing fails. Doctor Jonathan Papson shares nicknames he’s earned at work, but it’s J-Paps medical skills that a power-boat racer needs after a spectacular high-speed crash. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey needs help to reset a dislocated shoulder.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: It’s training day at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as Doctors Emma West and Jonathan Papson run new doctors through their paces with make-believe trauma patients. Playtime is soon over as Drs Jonathan and Emmanuel Karpathakis examine a cyclist with glass stuck in his neck. Any movement could be catastrophic. Dr Michelle Thornhill and Dr Martin Dutch struggle to get oxygen into a young mother having seizures. Dr Mya Cubitt uses her phone light to see where her young patient is bleeding from.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency department creates a puzzle for Dr Jonathan Papson: a teenage rugby player who received a hard tackle seems uninjured, so why is he struggling to breathe? Dr Terry Kane, who came to Australia on a whim, faces the worst trauma he’s dealt with. A motorcyclist has a broken pelvis and could bleed to death. Nurse Chelsea Jones also fears his forgetfulness might not be from painkillers but a brain bleed. Dr Steve Pinkus has shocking news for a heart patient.
